row_count.evidence: dataset test CSV and Space/tutorial validators

direct_columns.encoding: numeric prediction for each direct-inhibition pIC50 target

tdi_columns.order_status: unresolved; tutorial observes CYP3A4 then CYP2D6 while Space observes CYP2D6 then CYP3A4
tdi_columns.encoding: boolean prediction; tutorial validator accepts True/False, 1/0, or 1.0/0.0

direct_inhibition.measurement: direct-inhibition pIC50; released tables carry conf_low/conf_high bounds and standard deviations
direct_inhibition.interval_terminology: unresolved; dataset/tutorial call the bounds 95% confidence intervals while Space/blog call them credible intervals
direct_inhibition.semantics: Preserve raw values, available bounds, missingness, and source identity. No raw curves, censor qualifiers, per-row assay/probe state, QC, or label-origin fields are released; do not invent them.

tdi.measurement: operational binary +NADPH versus -NADPH IC50-shift state; not proof of an irreversible mechanism
tdi.public_definition: A positive is described as an IC50 shift exceeding two-fold after preincubation; low-activity cases include inferred-positive and assigned-negative rules.
tdi.release_consistency_conflict: Among non-null labels, every row missing either pIC50 arm is False (CYP2D6: 4; CYP3A4: 1,250, including 1,055 direct-missing rows with TDI pIC50 >= 4.301). All non-null both-arm rows match TDI > max(direct, 4) + log10(2). This observed relation is an M2/M6/P6 conflict, not a derivation rule to extrapolate.
tdi.semantics: Keep direct-arm values, TDI-arm values, intervals, and unresolved label states separate; never infer a challenge label from a proxy assay.

direct.name: MA-ST-RAE
direct.public_prose: Macro-averaged soft-threshold relative absolute error; predictions inside fitted bounds receive zero error and low-activity observations have reduced influence.

family_whole_in_one_population.note: Exact parent IDs, family membership, overlap resolution, and live mask are unpublished.

ranked_team_identity.value: one account/entry per cooperating team or lab; repeated per-track uploads are allowed

timeline_utc.note: The interim reveal is performance, not ground-truth labels.

external_and_pretrained_use.disclosure: proprietary training data must be disclosed

innovative_ml_recognition.value: discretionary; public code and a reachable repository link are required by the Space FAQ

structure_track.value: not live; size remains TODO in public Space

project_policy.value: No metric-specific optimization, threshold tuning, or score-driven repair is authorized while metric semantics remain unresolved.

direct_TRACE.purpose: Primary direct-inhibition evaluation under complete analog-family holdout.
invariants: no molecule, exact duplicate, or analog family crosses the evaluation boundary
fit selection/calibration/thresholds/error models only from cross-fitted predictions
preserve available bounds and missingness; do not invent censor states

global_TDI.purpose: Permanent fallback TDI evaluation with one global molecule/family assignment across CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.
invariants: same structure receives one assignment across TDI isoforms
thresholds, if needed, are selected only from grouped out-of-fold predictions

TDI_TRACE.purpose: Deferred optional research branch only after direct_TRACE and global_TDI are frozen; global_TDI remains the fallback.

V6: exact TDI label derivation and scorer masks
